description.en: Graph showing the variation of average binding energy per nucleon with mass number A.
description.hi: द्रव्यमान संख्या A के साथ प्रति न्यूक्लिऑन औसत बंधन ऊर्जा के परिवर्तन को दर्शाने वाला ग्राफ।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 350" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(50, 300)">
    <!-- Axes -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="400" y2="0" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="160" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Mass Number (A)</text>
    
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="-270" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="-40" y="-150" transform="rotate(-90, -40, -150)" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Binding Energy per Nucleon (MeV)</text>

    <!-- BE Curve -->
    <path d="M 10 -30 Q 30 -200 80 -250 T 150 -255 T 250 -230 T 350 -210" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3" />

    <!-- Key points on curve -->
    <circle cx="84" cy="-258" r="4" fill="#111827" />
    <text x="80" y="-270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Fe (56)</text>
    <text x="95" y="-240" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#4b5563">Max (~8.8 MeV)</text>

    <circle cx="350" cy="-210" r="4" fill="#111827" />
    <text x="340" y="-190" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">U (238)</text>
    <text x="340" y="-225" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#4b5563">~7.6 MeV</text>

    <!-- Regions -->
    <!-- Fusion Region -->
    <line x1="45" y1="0" x2="45" y2="-240" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="5" y="-80" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#3b82f6" font-weight="bold">Fusion</text>

    <!-- Fission Region -->
    <line x1="250" y1="0" x2="250" y2="-230" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="280" y="-80" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#3b82f6" font-weight="bold">Fission</text>

    <!-- Y-axis ticks -->
    <line x1="-5" y1="-60" x2="5" y2="-60" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="-15" y="-55" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">2</text>
    
    <line x1="-5" y1="-120" x2="5" y2="-120" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="-15" y="-115" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">4</text>

    <line x1="-5" y1="-180" x2="5" y2="-180" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="-15" y="-175" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">6</text>

    <line x1="-5" y1="-240" x2="5" y2="-240" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="1" />
    <text x="-15" y="-235" font-family="Arial" font-size="12">8</text>
  </g>
</svg>
